data.text: The migration writes no code and no tests: it is data, produced by doc add --file, which is already covered. The acceptance criterion about tests written first has nothing to attach to. What was verified instead: 67 documents fold with the labels the script predicted, 404 links resolve, the journal grew 200 KB to 1.01 MB against the 5 MB budget, every command stayed under 120 ms, and the suite is unchanged at 1118.
